description: This Java class 'DefaultEdqsMapper' implements serialization and deserialization logic for various EdqsObject types, including handling of data points with compression, and mapping of specific object types to byte arrays for storage or transmission.

classes.name: DefaultEdqsMapper
classes.description: Implements serialization/deserialization for EdqsObjects, handles compression of data points, and maps object types to byte arrays.

classes.name: JsonMapper
classes.description: Generic JSON serializer/deserializer for EdqsObjects using Jackson, with string interning.

classes.name: Mapper
classes.description: Interface defining methods for serializing, deserializing, and getting keys for EdqsObjects.

classes.name: InterningStringDeserializer
classes.description: Custom Jackson deserializer that interns strings for memory efficiency.

methods.name: toDataPointProto
methods.description: Converts a KvEntry to a DataPointProto, applying compression if necessary.

methods.name: fromDataPointProto
methods.description: Creates a DataPoint from a DataPointProto, decompressing if needed.

methods.name: compress
methods.description: Compresses a string using Snappy compression.

methods.name: uncompress
methods.description: Uncompresses a byte array into a string using Snappy.

methods.name: toEntity
methods.description: Converts a generic object to an Entity with type and fields.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an EdqsObject into a byte array based on its type.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte array into an EdqsObject of a specified type.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Retrieves the key for an EdqsObject.
